mapper.select: select (case when degree = 1 then '初中' when degree = 2 then '高中' when degree = 3 then '本科' when degree = 4 then '硕士' when degree = 5 then '博士' else '未知' end) as name , count(*) as value from student group by degree
select c.name, count(*) as value from student as s right join clazz as c on s.clazz_id = c.id group by c.name
